milestones.title: Stage 0: Foundation
milestones.description: Repository, environment, first run on a device, golden set, user research (Days 1-4).

milestones.title: Stage 1: Local MVP
milestones.description: Offline tracker: add jobs, statuses, reminders, share extension, export (Days 5-21).

milestones.title: Stage 2: Backend and AI
milestones.description: API, sync, AI job parsing, profile, resume tailoring (about weeks 4-8).

milestones.title: Stage 3: Interview prep
milestones.description: Questions, rubric, history, voice, weak-spot map (about weeks 9-12).

milestones.title: Stage 4: Web, integrations, launch
milestones.description: Web client, analytics, subscriptions, beta, public release (about weeks 13-17).

milestones.title: Ideas
milestones.description: Not scheduled. Promote an idea only after real usage shows the need.

issues.title: Day 1: Repository and environment
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Create a private GitHub repo, push the project
- [ ] Run `./scripts/setup.sh`
- [ ] Confirm CI is green on GitHub
- [ ] Install missing tooling (Xcode, Android Studio, Docker)

## Done when
`pnpm --filter @jc/shared test` is green locally and in CI.

## Devlog
Intro episode: why I am building this and the plan.

issues.title: Day 2: Mobile app running on a real phone
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Run `./scripts/bootstrap-mobile.sh`
- [ ] Merge `app.config.example.ts` into the Expo config, set your own bundle id / package
- [ ] Build a dev build (`npx expo run:ios` or EAS) and run it on a physical device

## Done when
The empty Jobs list opens on the phone.

## Risks
The first native build can take long. Expo Go is not supported (see ADR 0003).

issues.title: Day 3: Monitoring and your private golden set
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Add Sentry, confirm a test error arrives (with PII scrubbing in `beforeSend`)
- [ ] Create EAS profiles: development, preview
- [ ] Collect 10 real postings into `golden-set/private/` (anonymized, labeled by hand)
- [ ] Run `node golden-set/eval.mjs --dir golden-set/private`

## Done when
Sentry shows the test event and you have a recorded baseline score.

issues.title: Day 4: User research and sketches
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Send 5-10 interview requests (script in `docs/07-user-research.md`)
- [ ] Sketch 5 screens: list, details, add, reminders, settings
- [ ] Create a waitlist page (Tally / Carrd)

## Done when
5+ messages sent, sketches exist, waitlist link is live.

issues.title: Day 5: Database and migrations
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Drizzle migration applies on app start
- [ ] Verify the tables via a debug screen or logs

## Done when
After an app restart the schema is in place with no errors.

issues.title: Day 6: SqliteJobRepository
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Wire `SqliteJobRepository` through `RepoProvider`
- [ ] Verify create/list/get/delete via a temporary debug screen
- [ ] Make sure `listJobs` is a single query, not N+1
- [ ] Add repository tests (Jest + SQLite)

## Done when
Data survives a restart; deletes are soft (row stays with `deletedAt`).

issues.title: Day 7: List and add screens
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Empty state, form validation
- [ ] Duplicate check by normalized URL

## Done when
You add 5 jobs manually; a duplicate URL (with utm params) warns.

issues.title: Day 8: Details screen and statuses
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Status changes only through allowed transitions
- [ ] History and notes
- [ ] Tests for `syncFollowUp` with a fake repository

## Done when
An invalid transition is impossible in the UI and shows a clear message.

issues.title: Day 9: Reminders
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Notification permission flow
- [ ] Create follow-up when a job moves to Applied
- [ ] Reschedule on app start
- [ ] Temporary 'remind in 1 minute' debug mode

## Done when
A notification actually arrives on the phone.

## Risks
iOS keeps only ~64 scheduled local notifications; verify `selectNotificationsToSchedule`.

issues.title: Day 10: Share extension (iOS)
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Configure `expo-share-intent`
- [ ] Accept URL and text from Safari / LinkedIn / DOU

## Done when
Share -> Job Pocket Copilot from Safari opens the add form with the URL.

## Risks
Needs a dev build; does not work in Expo Go.

issues.title: Day 11: Share (Android) and simple text parsing
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Android intent filter
- [ ] Use the first line of shared text as a title suggestion

## Done when
The same flow works from Chrome on Android; the title is prefilled sensibly.

issues.title: Day 12: Filters, search, kanban
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Status filter and text search
- [ ] Simple kanban (horizontal columns)

## Done when
30 test jobs filter without lag.

issues.title: Day 13: Export, import, settings
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Export JSON and CSV via the share sheet
- [ ] Import JSON validated with `ExportBundleSchema`
- [ ] Settings: follow-up delay, hour, skip weekends

## Done when
Export -> wipe data -> import restores everything.

issues.title: Day 14: Quality and accessibility
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Dark theme, uk/en localization
- [ ] Error boundary, Sentry breadcrumbs
- [ ] VoiceOver / TalkBack pass on the main screens

## Done when
No unhandled crash on any screen; fonts scale.

issues.title: Days 15-20: Dogfooding week
issues.body:
Use the app for real applications. No new features, bug fixes only.

## Steps
- [ ] Keep `docs/pain-log.md` up to date
- [ ] At least 10 real jobs tracked

## Done when
The pain log has real entries and you know what annoys you.

issues.title: Day 21: Stage 1 retrospective
issues.body:
## Steps
- [ ] Retrospective (template in `docs/08-devlog-youtube.md`)
- [ ] Internal TestFlight build
- [ ] Check metrics: add-a-job under 20 s, export works, reminders fire
- [ ] Decide the Stage 2 scope from the pain log

## Done when
Stage 2 scope is decided from evidence, not assumptions.

issues.title: Week 4: API foundation
issues.body:
- [ ] NestJS runs against Postgres, first migration (`prisma migrate dev --name init`)
- [ ] Firebase guard working with a real token
- [ ] `/jobs` CRUD, OpenAPI at `/openapi.json`
- [ ] Generate `packages/api-client`
- [ ] e2e tests for `/health` and `/jobs`
- [ ] Replace manual zod validation with DTOs (`nestjs-zod`)

issues.title: Week 5: Sync
issues.body:
- [ ] API-backed `JobRepository` with a local cache
- [ ] Outbox with idempotency keys
- [ ] First-login migration of local data
- [ ] Account deletion (DB rows + files)

## Risks
Conflict handling; keep it to last-write-wins by `updatedAt`.

issues.title: Week 6: AI job parsing
issues.body:
- [ ] Real `LlmClient` implementation behind `LLM_PROVIDER`
- [ ] Structured output validated with `ParsedJobSchema`, retry on invalid JSON
- [ ] Cache by text hash + parser version
- [ ] Daily limits and `AiUsage` accounting
- [ ] Evals on the golden set (before/after)
- [ ] Screenshot (vision) path

## Done when
Parsing accuracy meets your chosen threshold on the golden set.

issues.title: Week 7: Profile and job match
issues.body:
- [ ] Import resume (PDF/DOCX) into a structured profile
- [ ] User confirms and edits the profile
- [ ] Match profile vs. job with references to profile lines

issues.title: Week 8: Resume tailoring
issues.body:
- [ ] Suggested changes as a diff; accept/reject each change
- [ ] Every change has a `sourceRef`; no source -> needs confirmation
- [ ] PDF export and cover letter

## Done when
No change ever introduces a fact missing from the profile.

issues.title: Week 9: Interview questions and rubric
issues.body:
- [ ] Generate questions per job (behavioral, technical, English), text mode
- [ ] Rubric scoring with JSON feedback
- [ ] Rewritten answers use only the user's own facts

issues.title: Week 10: Session history and repetition
issues.body:
- [ ] Store sessions and turns
- [ ] Re-practice questions that scored low

issues.title: Week 11: Voice mode
issues.body:
- [ ] Recording, STT, AI reply, optional TTS (push-to-talk first)
- [ ] Pause / filler-word / pace metrics from STT timestamps
- [ ] Cost per 15-minute session calculated before launch; minutes limit

## Risks
Audio session, Bluetooth headsets and interruptions (calls, Siri): test on real devices.

issues.title: Week 12: Weak-spot map and study plan
issues.body:
- [ ] Aggregate weak spots across jobs and sessions
- [ ] 1-2 week mini study plan (topics and exercises, no invented links)
- [ ] Polish and device testing

issues.title: Week 13: Web client (Next.js)
issues.body:
- [ ] Login, job list, details, parsing
- [ ] Reuse `packages/api-client` and shared zod schemas

issues.title: Week 14: Resume editor and funnel analytics
issues.body:
- [ ] Web resume editor
- [ ] Funnel analytics: conversions between statuses, time per stage, response rate per resume version

issues.title: Week 15: Recruiter emails and subscriptions
issues.body:
- [ ] Forwarding address for recruiter emails (parse and suggest a status update)
- [ ] RevenueCat (mobile) + Stripe (web); entitlements stored on the backend
- [ ] AI limits per plan

## Risks
Gmail restricted scopes may require Google verification; check current requirements first. Re-check store rules for web payments by region.

issues.title: Week 16: Closed beta
issues.body:
- [ ] TestFlight + Google Play closed testing, 20-50 users
- [ ] Feedback channel and a weekly review of feedback

issues.title: Week 17: Public release
issues.body:
- [ ] Walk through `docs/09-release-checklist.md`
- [ ] ASO, store listings, privacy labels
- [ ] Launch post and devlog episode

issues.title: Idea: browser extension to save jobs from LinkedIn / DOU / Djinni
issues.body: Save a posting from the desktop browser into the same account. Only user-initiated saves (no crawling).

issues.title: Idea: Telegram bot for quick adding and reminders
issues.body: Forward a posting to the bot; get follow-up reminders in Telegram.

issues.title: Idea: weekly digest
issues.body: What was done this week, what is waiting for a reply, what needs a follow-up.

issues.title: Idea: home screen widget with application statuses
issues.body: iOS and Android widgets showing counts per status and the next reminder.

issues.title: Idea: calendar integration for interviews
issues.body: Add interview slots to the calendar and create reminders automatically.

issues.title: Idea: compare resume versions by recruiter response
issues.body: Which resume version gets more replies? Needs enough data to be meaningful.

issues.title: Idea: mentor mode
issues.body: Let a mentor view progress and comment on answers. Needs a sharing and permissions model first.
